data.action: 双手交叠腹前优雅漫步颔首行礼，制服与百褶裙端庄得体，笑容温婉无瑕
data.description: 彩南高中明亮整洁的木质走廊上，窗外绿树成荫。梦梦双手端庄地交叠在小腹前，身穿彩南水手服制服百褶裙，黑丝过膝袜衬托出修长匀称的美腿。她微微侧身向迎面走来的老师与同学温和颔首致意，粉色短发垂落耳侧，脸上带着无可挑剔的大家闺秀甜美微笑，任谁也想不到这具纯良躯壳下隐藏着何等惊人的小恶魔心机。
data.lighting: 长排大窗透入的纯白自然采光与木地板的反光
data.location: 教学楼洒满阳光的木质走廊中央
data.promptProse: In the center of Sainan High School's sunlit wooden corridor, Momo pauses gracefully in her neatly arranged sailor uniform with both hands folded softly before her waist. She inclines her head with an immaculate, warm smile toward a teacher and uniformed classmates approaching farther down the bright hallway. Natural morning sunlight pours through the tall row of classroom windows lined with green trees outside, glinting across the polished floorboards.
data.title: 梦梦 · 学园走廊的优雅淑女步
data.animaCaption: Pausing in the sunlit wooden school hallway with both hands neatly folded before her waist, Momo inclines her head with a gentle smile toward the teacher and classmates approaching down the corridor. Bright morning light through the tall windows reflects across the floorboards.
